title: Site settings
intro: The site's name, logo, colors, social links, interface languages, and search-engine visibility. Saving refreshes every public page, feed, and icon.
fallbackNotice: The settings have not been saved yet. Fallback values are shown; the first save creates the settings.
noSiteUrl: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is not set: the site stays closed to search engines regardless of this setting, and no feeds are published.

denied.title: No access to site settings
denied.description: Only admins can change the site settings.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: The name and texts shown in titles, the browser tab, feeds, and the footer. They are the same in every interface language.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Logos, icon, and accent color. The light and dark theme follow the visitor's system preference.

social.title: Social links
social.description: Shown in the footer and declared in structured data (sameAs). Only https addresses are accepted.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface languages offered to visitors. Addresses contain no language; it is chosen from the browser language and the language cookie.

seo.title: Search and sharing
seo.description: The description and image used in search results and share previews.

fields.siteNameHint: Shown in tab titles, feeds, and the header when there is no logo.
fields.taglineHint: Optional. Used as the feed subtitle and on the generated share image.
fields.footerTextHint: Optional. The tagline is shown when it is empty. Line breaks are kept.
fields.metaDescriptionHint: Search description of the home page and general pages. The tagline is used when it is empty.
fields.logoLightHint: Shown in the header in the light theme. Without a logo the site name is shown.
fields.logoDarkHint: Shown in the dark theme and on the share image. The light logo is used when it is empty.
fields.iconHint: Browser tab and home screen icon. Must be square and at least 48 pixels. Without one, the first letter of the site name is shown on the accent color.
fields.ogImageHint: Shown when a page without a cover image is shared. At least 200×200, ideally 1200×630 pixels. Without one, an image is generated from the site name.
fields.accentColorHint: In #rrggbb format. Used for buttons, link buttons, and focus rings. Neutral colors are used when it is empty.
fields.socialHint: Full https address, for example https://github.com/username
fields.enabledLocalesHint: At least one language must be selected. With a single language the language switcher is hidden.
fields.defaultLocaleHint: Used when the browser language matches none of the enabled languages. Feeds use this language too.
fields.searchIndexing: Allow search engines to index the site
fields.searchIndexingHint: When off, every page sends noindex, robots.txt blocks crawling, and the sitemap is empty.

media.libraryError: The media library could not be loaded.
media.fileHelp: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF, up to 5 MB. SVG is not accepted.
media.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
media.failed: The upload could not be completed. Try again.

accent.adjusted: For readability this theme uses {color} (at least 4.5:1 contrast).
accent.none: No accent color; the neutral theme colors are used.

validation.invalidColor: Enter the color as #rrggbb, for example #2563eb.
validation.socialNotHttps: The address must start with https://.
validation.socialWrongHost: The address must be on this service's own domain.
validation.socialTooLong: The address can be at most {max} characters.
validation.defaultNotEnabled: The default language must be one of the enabled languages.

errors.forbidden: Only admins can change the site settings.
errors.stale: Someone else changed the settings while you were editing. Your input was kept; reload the page and apply your changes again.
errors.mediaMissing: The selected image is no longer in the media library.
errors.iconShape: The icon must be square and at least 48 pixels.
errors.ogImageSize: The share image must be at least 200 pixels on each side.
